milestone_description: China to "realise mass production by 2025" of humanoid robots; establish innovation system; breakthrough key technologies; secure supply of core components.
notes: Initial MIIT humanoid roadmap published Nov 2023.

milestone_description: By 2027, humanoids become "important new engine of economic growth" with secure supply chain and "deep integration into the real economy"; China to become world leader.
notes: Same Nov 2023 roadmap. 2027 timeline aligns with mid-2025-2030 15th Five-Year Plan.

milestone_description: China publishes first national standard system for humanoid robots and embodied intelligence.
notes: Feb 2026 announcement. Marks transition from policy goal-setting to operational standards.

milestone_description: IFR press release: "wide adoption of AI with traditional industrial robotics is expected over the next five to ten years"; humanoid commercialization "towards the end of the [15th Five-Year] plan period"
notes: IFR observation (not policy). Aligns with 2026-2030 plan horizon.

milestone_description: Optimus production begins Fremont late July/August 2026. Second factory Giga Texas summer 2027. Musk DECLINED to provide 2026 production target.
notes: Reduction from earlier "thousands by year end" guidance — significant signal.

milestone_description: Tesla annual capex raised to >$25B for 2026 — roughly 3x 2025 spend. Significant share to Optimus production lines + AI compute + robotics facility at Giga Texas.
notes: Per Tesla Q1 2026 earnings call. Specific Optimus allocation not disclosed.

milestone_description: Apptronik $935M total Series A funding; commercial pilots with Mercedes-Benz, GXO Logistics, Jabil
Figure $1B+ Series C committed at $39B post-money. BMW Spartanburg commercial pilot.
$1.4B raised at >$14B valuation (SoftBank-led). Software-focused (cross-embodiment AI brain).
notes: Largest single humanoid-related round to date. Software focus differentiates from hardware-first players.
